title: UK CPI, February 2027 (ONS, 07:00 London / 02:00 ET) — the print that actually carries the second weights update and the annual basket update, five weeks after the date three lanes diarised for it
source: EST: ons.gov.uk/releases/consumerpriceinflationukfebruary2027, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 42,073 bytes) — the ONS release page reads verbatim 'Consumer price inflation, UK: February 2027', 'Provisional release date: 24 March 2027 7:00am', 'This release is not yet published'. The claim that this is the weights/basket venue is ONS's own, from the January 2026 bulletin (released 18 February 2026, fetched direct HTTP 200): 'The second update will be introduced, along with the usual basket update, with the February indices released on 25 March 2026.' Filed estimate on ONS's Provisional label, on this lane's no-self-confirm limit, and on the standing taxonomy gap (market-events-data.ts has no confirmed prefix for the UK Office for National Statistics). Proposed by the never-assessed initial research of uk-cpi-2027-02-17, 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED BY THE uk-cpi-2027-02-17 LANE, 2026-09-09, TO CORRECT A DATE THREE LANES SHARE. uk-cpi-2027-05-19, uk-cpi-2027-11-17 and uk-electricity-vat-reversion-2027-04-01 all point kill switches (and one registered forward test, FT-uk-cpi-2027-11-17-3, score-by 2027-02-17) at the January print on 2027-02-17 as the date the 2027 electricity weight resolves. It does not resolve there. ONS's 'double update' methodology, introduced in 2017 and restated verbatim in the updating-weights article released 16 March 2026, runs a FIRST weight update for the January indices only and a SECOND for the February-to-December indices. The published annex (Annex A Tables W1-W3, parsed direct 2026-09-09) carries both columns per year, and the MM23 series CJXA — the series that forward test predicts — equals the FEBRUARY-TO-DECEMBER value in 6 of 6 years where the two differ (2017 16 vs 17, 2019 18 vs 17, 2023 26 vs 27, 2024 22.2747 vs 23.3142, 2025 18.9060 vs 19.1488, 2026 19.7795 vs 20.6065) and the January value in none of them. THE OPERATIVE WEIGHT IS THIS PRINT'S, NOT THE JANUARY ONE, and the distinction is load-bearing rather than pedantic: the electricity VAT reversion is 2027-04-01, so both the April 2027 print and the October 2027 base effect fall inside the February-to-December window that this release opens. The explanatory article has published in MARCH in all ten years 2017-2026 (20 Mar, 19 Mar, 18 Mar, 19 Mar, 15 Mar, 14 Mar, 13 Mar, 11 Mar, 18 Mar, 16 Mar) and never in February. This print also carries the annual BASKET update, which the proposals for 2027-02-17 attributed to the January print. Tiered LOW on the same measurement as every UK entry here: symbols [], no UK listing, gilt or sterling instrument on this calendar. Estimate widens caution only.
